LINE  1021 | LINE 56 | 
LINE  1022 | LINE 57 | ## 🚀 Características Principales
LINE  1023 | LINE 58 | 
LINE  1024 | LINE 59 | 1. **Sin dependencias de API ni llamadas HTTP**: Funciona 100% offline y sin necesidad de claves de API.
LINE  1025 | LINE 60 | 2. **Selección Flexible de Archivos**:
LINE  1026 | LINE 61 |    - **Máximo 1 Carpeta de Proyecto**: Al seleccionar una nueva carpeta, se reemplaza la anterior.
LINE  1027 | LINE 62 |    - **N Archivos Individuales**: Permite sumar cualquier cantidad de archivos sueltos desde distintas ubicaciones.
LINE  1028 | LINE 63 |    - Soporta combinaciones: `1 Carpeta + N Archivos`, `Solo 1 Carpeta`, o `Solo N Archivos`.
LINE  1029 | LINE 64 | 3. **Exclusiones Dinámicas Configurables**:
LINE  1030 | LINE 65 |    - Omite por defecto `.git`, `node_modules`, `__pycache__`, `venv`, `.venv`, `dist`, `build`, `.idea`, `.vscode`.
LINE  1031 | LINE 66 |    - Permite editar la lista de directorios excluidos directamente desde la interfaz.
LINE  1032 | LINE 67 | 4. **Formateo para LLM Web Chat**:
LINE  1033 | LINE 68 |    - Agrega árbol de directorio de la carpeta del proyecto.
LINE  1034 | LINE 69 |    - Formatea el código con números de línea (`1 | código...`).
LINE  1035 | LINE 70 |    - Permite copiar directamente al portapapeles o guardar el documento generado en la carpeta `output/` o donde desees.
LINE  1036 | LINE 71 |

LINE  1479 | LINE 259 |     def _extract_keywords(self, problem_desc: str) -> Tuple[Set[str], List[str]]:
LINE  1480 | LINE 260 |         """Extracts individual tokens and key multi-word phrases from problem description."""
LINE  1481 | LINE 261 |         if not problem_desc:
LINE  1482 | LINE 262 |             return set(), []
LINE  1483 | LINE 263 | 
LINE  1484 | LINE 264 |         cleaned = problem_desc.lower()
LINE  1485 | LINE 265 |         # Find snake_case or camelCase or slash paths or dot notations
LINE  1486 | LINE 266 |         tokens = re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_\-\.\/]+', cleaned)
LINE  1487 | LINE 267 | 
LINE  1488 | LINE 268 |         keywords: Set[str] = set()
LINE  1489 | LINE 269 |         key_phrases: List[str] = []
LINE  1490 | LINE 270 | 
LINE  1491 | LINE 271 |         for t in tokens:
LINE  1492 | LINE 272 |             # Split slash paths or dot notation
LINE  1493 | LINE 273 |             sub_parts = re.split(r'[\/\.]', t)
LINE  1494 | LINE 274 |             for part in sub_parts:
LINE  1495 | LINE 275 |                 part_clean = part.strip("_ -")
LINE  1496 | LINE 276 |                 if len(part_clean) > 2 and part_clean not in STOP_WORDS:
LINE  1497 | LINE 277 |                     keywords.add(part_clean)
LINE  1498 | LINE 278 |                     # Add singular/plural variants
LINE  1499 | LINE 279 |                     if part_clean.endswith("s") and len(part_clean) > 3:
LINE  1500 | LINE 280 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-1])
LINE  1501 | LINE 281 |                     elif not part_clean.endswith("s"):
LINE  1502 | LINE 282 |                         keywords.add(part_clean + "s")
LINE  1503 | LINE 283 |                     
LINE  1504 | LINE 284 |                     # Add verb stem variants (-ing, -ed, -tion)
LINE  1505 | LINE 285 |                     if part_clean.endswith("ing") and len(part_clean) > 5:
LINE  1506 | LINE 286 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-3])
LINE  1507 | LINE 287 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-3] + "e")
LINE  1508 | LINE 288 |                     elif part_clean.endswith("ed") and len(part_clean) > 4:
LINE  1509 | LINE 289 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-2])
LINE  1510 | LINE 290 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-1])
LINE  1511 | LINE 291 |                     elif part_clean.endswith("tion") and len(part_clean) > 6:
LINE  1512 | LINE 292 |                         keywords.add(part_clean[:-4] + "te")
LINE  1513 | LINE 293 | 
LINE  1514 | LINE 294 |         # Multi-word phrase extraction (e.g. "creating users" -> "create user", "users")
LINE  1515 | LINE 295 |         words = [w for w in re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', cleaned) if len(w) > 2 and w not in STOP_WORDS]
LINE  1516 | LINE 296 |         for i in range(len(words) - 1):
LINE  1517 | LINE 297 |             key_phrases.append(f"{words[i]} {words[i+1]}")

LINE  1532 | LINE 312 |

LINE  1536 | LINE 316 |

LINE  1557 | LINE 337 |                         score += 12.0

LINE  1559 | LINE 339 |                         reasons.append(f"Define símbolo/clase/función '{kw}'")
LINE  1560 | LINE 340 |                     elif not any(kw in r for r in reasons):
LINE  1561 | LINE 341 |                         reasons.append(f"Contenido menciona '{kw}' ({occurrences} veces)")
LINE  1562 | LINE 342 | 
LINE  1563 | LINE 343 |             for phrase in key_phrases:
LINE  1564 | LINE 344 |                 if phrase in lower_content:
LINE  1565 | LINE 345 |                     score += 5.0
LINE  1566 | LINE 346 |

LINE  5481 | LINE  24 |     for null characters or non-text control bytes.
LINE  5482 | LINE  25 |     """
LINE  5483 | LINE  26 |     ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()

LINE  5485 | LINE  28 |         return True

LINE  5487 | LINE  30 |     try:
LINE  5488 | LINE  31 |         with open(path, 'rb') as f:
LINE  5489 | LINE  32 |             chunk = f.read(1024)
LINE  5490 | LINE  33 |             if b'\x00' in chunk:
LINE  5491 | LINE  34 |                 return True
LINE  5492 | LINE  35 |             # High proportion of non-printable bytes indicates binary
LINE  5493 | LINE  36 |             if chunk:
LINE  5494 | LINE  37 |                 non_text = sum(1 for byte in chunk if byte < 9 or (13 < byte < 32) or byte == 127)
LINE  5495 | LINE  38 |                 if non_text / len(chunk) > 0.3:
LINE  5496 | LINE  39 |                     return True

LINE 175 |     def test_max_file_size_line_counting_limit(self):
LINE 176 |         """Tests that files exceeding max_file_size_mb leave lines_in_file = 0 without reading."""
LINE 177 |         temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="test_max_size_")
LINE 178 |         try:
LINE 179 |             # Create a file with content
LINE 180 |             large_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, "large.py")
LINE 181 |             with open(large_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
LINE 182 |                 f.write("line\n" * 100)
LINE 183 | 
LINE 184 |             analyzer = ProjectAnalyzer(allowed_extensions={".py"})
LINE 185 |             # Pass max_file_size_mb tiny enough so 100 lines (~500 bytes) exceeds max_file_bytes
LINE 186 |             result = analyzer.analyze(temp_dir, max_file_size_mb=0.0001)  # ~104 bytes max
LINE 187 | 
LINE 188 |             large_file_info = next(f for f in result.large_files if f["path"] == "large.py")
